chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said:
Whoever enters the grave should not exit from it except by the side of the feet.

key_terms.مِنْ قِبَلِ الرِّجْلَيْنِ: from the side of the feet

ai.seo_question: How should a person exit the grave after entering it during a burial according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling on proper conduct when entering a grave during burial. It indicates a specific funerary etiquette: one who enters the grave should leave from the side of the feet.
